name: TrakSpool Firmware
changes: Fixed false "Refill Detected" popups after consuming filament — transient weights during spool placement/removal could corrupt the tag's consumed value
Tag writes and refill/empty-correction decisions now require the weight to be genuinely settled (within 2g for 2s) and the tag to be firmly present
Refill and empty-correction confirmation windows are now real wall-clock time (3s) instead of loop ticks
Refill detection threshold default raised to 400g (user-set values are kept)
